raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.23.3"

package:
  name: mistral-vibe
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/m/mistral-vibe/mistral_vibe-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 89da5ae8e74482ec322c67acd55ab454e2da9d1ca65c23836354fab9c0883dba
    patches:
      - 0001-Relax-constraints-on-dependencies.patch

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - match(python, "<3.12")
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check
  python:
    entry_points:
      - vibe = vibe.cli.entrypoint:main
      - vibe-acp = vibe.acp.entrypoint:main
      - vibe-app-server = vibe.app_server.stdio:main

requirements:
  build:
    - python
    - hatchling =1.31.0
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    - python
    - hatchling =1.31.0
    - pip
  run:
